newsitem.title: UK: Sellers mixed on quiet UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Sellers mixed on quiet UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Higher Chicago futures at the end of last week kept most buyers out of the UK meals and feeds market on Monday.
Selling levels were mixed with high protein soymeal ex-mill one stg up to one stg down while stores were one stg higher.
Brazilian 48 percent protein soymeal was unchanged ex-store Liverpool and 1.50 stg down on the east coast.
In quiet trading spot Cargill rapemeal ex-Liverpool fetched 125 stg on the resale market.
